I will put both chemical fertilizer from the cooperative and manure from my cattle on this sorghum plot, because the soil needs strength to produce well. I plant my own saved seed every year, as improved sorghum seed is not available in our area and my seed grows reliably. My family will handle all the work on this small plot, and we do not spray chemicals or use irrigation since we depend on the rains.
